premise: In the long night everyone sleeps but Robot; Robo-dog shows him how: sit, watch the station go round, and round, and round… and power down.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Nightingale' (the mechanical bird that never rests), turned: the mechanical friend learns to rest.
lesson: Rest is something you can learn from a friend.

en-US.title: The Robot Who Wanted to Dream
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [whispers] It was the middle of the long Moon night, and the whole base was asleep. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face sleeping} Pilot snored softly. Everyone was asleep, except {robot:enter} Robot. {robot:face sad} I want to dream, he said. But robots don't know how. {robodog:enter} {robodog:go to robot} Robo-dog trotted over. {robodog:face happy} He knew a trick. {robodog:live} He sat up and looked at the sky. Robot looked too. {station:enter} There went the space station, gliding over. {station:live} It turned its wings, slow and gentle. Round it went. {robot:pulse} And round. And round… {robot:face sleeping} Robot's screen dimmed. {robot:live hold} He started a little dance and, halfway through, one arm up — powered down. {robodog:face sleeping} [softly] And there he stood all night, fast asleep in the middle of a dance, {all:face sleeping} dreaming about round things.

es-ES.title: El robot que quería soñar
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [whispers] Era la mitad de la larga noche lunar, y toda la base dormía. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face sleeping} Piloto roncaba bajito. Todos dormían, menos {robot:enter} Robot. {robot:face sad} Quiero soñar, dijo. Pero los robots no saben. {robodog:enter} {robodog:go to robot} Perro robot se acercó trotando. {robodog:face happy} Él conocía un truco. {robodog:live} Se sentó y miró al cielo. Robot miró también. {station:enter} Allá iba la estación espacial, deslizándose. {station:live} Giró sus alas, despacio, suave. Daba la vuelta. {robot:pulse} Y otra vuelta. Y otra… {robot:face sleeping} La pantalla de Robot se atenuó. {robot:live hold} Empezó un bailecito y, a medias, con un brazo en alto… se apagó. {robodog:face sleeping} [softly] Y allí se quedó toda la noche, dormido en mitad de un baile, {all:face sleeping} soñando con cosas redondas.
